notes:
Version 2.0.0 brings the app back in step with the server.

Live games no longer lose life changes. A tap that failed to reach the server used
to leave the wrong total on screen; life is now tracked as committed and pending
changes, retried properly, and sent as an absolute value so a retry cannot
double-apply it.

Life over the course of a game is recorded and drawn as a chart on game detail.

You can create an account, reset a forgotten password and verify your email
without leaving the app. Emailed links open here directly.

Pod invites, guest players for people without an account, and shareable public
game recaps — with per-recap control over whether names and decks are shown.

Deck rating tiers with a trend sparkline, global search over players and decks,
per-seat game details including monarch, poison and MMR change, and a rematch
button that carries the table into a new game.

Pod settings for your flavour name, accent colour, sharing and which mechanics
your group plays. Switch one off and it disappears from the life counter.

You can download everything the server holds about your account from Profile.
